messages:
mari: Kickoff for BlueOrbit integration + CloudShelf marketplace listing. Launch window 3 weeks. Scope: marketplace tile, 40m webinar (15m product + 20m live demo + 5m Q&A), co-auth blog, one-pager, and inbound lead routing. Need owner for HubSpot routing + GA/Segment mapping. :sparkles:

rachel: I can own the webinar landing page + emails. Will draft 2 persona flows: devs and platform. ETA Tue COB for first draft.

tim: I'll take marketplace metadata + creative (tile + hero). Need final 60-100 word blurb and logo by Mon. Also confirm CTA target.

anika: I'll own HubSpot routing and lead scoring. Recommend we send marketplace clicks to our reg page with utm_campaign=blueorbit_launch_2026 and utm_source=cloudshelf|email|webinar. Will post workflow skeleton.

mari: @anika upload your skeleton and list of contact properties we need. Also need decision on single vs dual registration pages.

anika: Workflow skeleton (HubSpot style):

```
workflow_name: blueorbit_inbound
triggers: utm_campaign == "blueorbit_launch_2026" AND utm_source IN ("cloudshelf","email","webinar")
actions: set contact.partner = "blueorbit", set contact.entry_point = source, assign team = partner-marketing, add tag = partner_blueorbit
```

anika: I'll add lead score rules (attended + demo_requested) and SLA for assignment (2 business hours).

tim: For marketplace CTA we prefer redirect to our reg page to preserve tracking. If CloudShelf uses native capture, ensure they redirect to our /thanks with utm params.

rachel: Email plan: announce, 48hr reminder, 2hr reminder. Two subject lines per persona for A/B. Also two social cards. I'll include audience selector on the form.

mari: Blog & one-pager owner? Need co-auth outline and key messaging by Fri. Who wants the brief?

rachel: I'll draft the blog outline. @tim please provide a short technical quote from BlueOrbit PM (one line) for the opener.

tim: Reaching out to BlueOrbit PM now for quote and sandbox creds for demo. Will update thread.

hubspot-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot reserved 2026-04-20 17:00 UTC. Calendar invites created.

anika: Tracking checklist: utm_campaign=blueorbit_launch_2026, utm_source=cloudshelf|email|webinar, utm_content=tile|card|email_variant. Segment event: blueorbit_registrant. GA funnel: impressions->clicks->signups->attendees->MQLs.

mari: Decision: single reg page with audience radio to reduce friction. Route to persona nurture based on contact.audience. Good?

tim: Good by me.

anika: I'll wire routing to branch nurture streams and set contact.audience mapping. Will publish HubSpot screenshots by Mon.

mari: Great. Weekly sync Wed 9am PT. Use this thread for all routing & tracking questions. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
